text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to let an exhausted Super
Creek rest in
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so terribly sorry for making you
worry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I should be the one taking care of you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll do just that. Good night,
Trainer.
choice_data_list: とにかく、今はゆっくり休んで

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a dream? I mean, it has to be,
right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aaawww! How adorable! Come here, you
little
cutie-pies!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you're so good at crawling! All
that hard
work deserves a rock-a-bye
reward! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh... I guess it really was a dream.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but I'm glad I could hold such
adorable
versions of the three of them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel all energized now. I have to let
Trainer
know! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek apparently got to hold the
baby
versions of Inari One, Tamamo
Cross, and Oguri
Cap. I don't quite get
it, but I'm glad she's feeling
better.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come on, just a little more...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So it was a dream... What a shame. I
could watch
them forever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Aww, I wish I got to hold them before waking up. Sigh...
